description: Mixer with Sliders: the Surge XT mixer section, three stereo inputs with two ring modulators and a filtered noise source, mixed with sliders

params.text: Sets the level of the first stereo input.
Sets the level of the second stereo input.
Sets the level of the third stereo input.
Sets the level of the internal noise generator.
Sets the level of the first and second inputs multiplied together.
Sets the level of the second and third inputs multiplied together.
Shapes the noise: low frequencies to the left, white noise in the middle, high frequencies to the right.
Sets the gain applied to the whole mix.
Takes that channel out of the mix; only the first input starts unmuted, and the first patch cable into the second or third input clears its mute.
Restricts the mix to the channels whose solo is on, and with any solo on the mute switches are ignored.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.

inputs.text: The left channel of that stereo input.
The right channel of that stereo input; with nothing patched the left input feeds both channels.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

outputs.text: The left channel of the mix.
The right channel of the mix.

notes: Only the first input starts unmuted. The noise and the two ring modulator channels stay silent until their M switch is cleared; a first cable into input 2 or 3 clears that channel's mute.
A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Meter Channel — a submenu choosing which polyphonic channel the level meter shows; it appears only while more than one channel is running.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
